slots_noted: CUnit::OrderToProvince is slot 6 of CUnit, CArmy, CNavy and CAir alike, and the record's vftable_slots already name CUnit slot 6 OrderToProvince; this fragment revises its comment only and adds no slot.

addresses.name: CUnit::OrderToProvince
addresses.signature: void __thiscall CUnit::OrderToProvince(CUnit* this, CMapProvince* province, bool append)
addresses.comment: **CUnit slot 6: a right click on a province with this unit selected.** A unit in a battle is never appended to. Nothing happens for a unit with no brigades, a retreating one, or one with an AI agent on a unit above it. For a land unit outside the battle plan branch: the province it stands in, with `append` clear or no path, posts a CCancelMovementCommand; a province CUnit::CanMoveTo refuses gets the `illegal_selection_projection` mark and the `error` sound; otherwise `legal_selection_projection`, the sound `army_move`, and `CMoveCommand(unit, province id, !append, 0, 0)`. **Every mark is CUnit_ShowOrderProjection's and made only for a unit whose is_selected (+4) is set.** **An air unit** (slot 17, read whole 2026-11-14): with no battle (+0x11C at most 0) and is_selected exactly 1, CInGameIdler::OpenOrdersView(1, ...) - whatever `append` says, Shift playing no part; otherwise the legal mark where selected and `CMoveCommand(unit, province id, clear = !append, safe 0, very safe 0)` - clear always set, `append` having been let go of in a battle - posted through the unit's in-game screen (+0x160, slot 18, then +0x38's slot 6) with **nothing tested**: neither slot 35 (CanMoveTo, CAir's cloud gate included) nor a range. Both arms then play `air_move` unless it is already playing (GetSound, Sound_NameToId, the sound's slot 25 and then slot 9). With several air units selected each gets this in turn: one in no battle after the first finds the window of mode 1 up and is left alone, one in a battle is still sent. A fleet where the sea joins (SeaConnected): with a path, its own province, a cancel; append clear, out of battle and selected, the orders window (kind 0); else `navy_move`, and COrder::IsTargetInRange decides a CMoveCommand with the legal mark or the illegal mark alone. Where the sea does not join: the orders window for a coast its first carried unit may stand in (append clear, out of battle), else the illegal mark and `error`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-movement.md, sections 1 and 13.2. **The battle plan branch**, read 2026-11-09: for a land unit of the player's with an agent (a unit under an agent above it has returned already), selected and above a division: a plain click posts CTogglePlanObjectiveCommand(unit, province); an appending click calls slot 29 (CUnit::SetPlanAxisTo), **and where that answers false returns with no sound and no mark**. Either plays `army_move` and leaves the legal mark; a division (oob level 4 and up) in that branch gets the illegal mark and `error`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-frontline.md, section 7.

Every other sentence unchanged, as are the signature, name and confidence.

addresses.name: CInGameIdler::OpenOrdersView
addresses.signature: void __stdcall CInGameIdler::OpenOrdersView(int mode@ECX, CInGameIdler* idler@EDX, CInGameIdler* owner@stack:4, CUnit* unit@stack:8, CMapProvince* province@stack:12)
addresses.comment: **Opens the window of orders a right click with a fleet or an air unit, or Ctrl and a right click with a land unit, brings up.** Nothing where the view at idler +0x160 is already of this mode (its slot 1) - asked whether or not the view is shown, and the view keeps the unit it was made for; otherwise the old view is closed and a new one made: mode 0 a CNavalOrdersView (0x274 bytes), 1 a CAirOrdersView (0x37C), 2 a CLandOrdersView (0x198). CUnit::OrderToProvince calls it with 0 for a fleet clicked without shift, 1 for an air unit in no battle whatever the shift key, 2 for a land unit with **Ctrl** held (the keyboard's slot 12, Keyboard_IsCtrlDown; FINDINGS-selection.md section A). Only an air window has the last one's settings restored (0x747300); a land window starts fresh each time. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-seaair.md, section 1, and reversing/findings/FINDINGS-landorders.md, section A.
addresses.revises: The comment only: the same-mode test is said to be asked whether or not the view is shown and to leave the view with its first unit, and the air caller is said to call it in no battle whatever the shift key. Signature, name and confidence unchanged.
addresses.evidence: Read on the listing 0x677260..0x677296: `mov ecx, [edi+0x160]; test ecx, ecx; je`, then `call [[ecx]+4]; cmp eax, esi; je 0x677364` - the end - with no read of a shown flag and nothing written to the view before the jump. Wrong if 0x677364 writes the unit or the province into the existing view; it is the epilogue's start.
